text:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly health check for Onboard Cohort B (integration partners). Notable: p95/p99 splits by route/model, streaming vs non-streaming — dropping numbers and flags below.

Devon (SRE): Pasting the last 24h snapshots per route/model: 
```
Route: /chat
  Model: alder-13b
    streaming p95: 220ms, p99: 420ms
    non-stream p95: 310ms, p99: 640ms
Route: /summarize
  Model: rubicon-7b-quant
    streaming p95: 140ms, p99: 240ms
    non-stream p95: 170ms, p99: 420ms
Route: /embed
  Model: raven-3.2
    streaming p95: 90ms, p99: 200ms
    non-stream p95: 130ms, p99: 360ms
```

Maya (CS): Observations: chat non-stream p99 is +120ms vs last week — looks correlated with sync fallbacks during heavy prefix loads. embed non-stream p99 also elevated on weekend spikes.

OpsBot: alert: Cohort-B spend +18% (24h) due to repeated sync fallbacks (policy: fallback-to-sync on kvcache-miss).

Jamal (AE): Heads-up for renewal: customer is watching performance. If this persists they may request a credit. Marking as potential renewal risk.

Sasha (PM): @Devon can you confirm whether batching/kvcache thresholds changed for Cohort B? Also we should get a one-pager for partners about streaming SDK to reduce fallbacks.

Devon (SRE): Quick triage notes:
- rollout/kernel: no recent kernel/kernsel changes for alder-13b
- autoscaling: brief pod churn at ~02:30 UTC (3/8 pods cycled) coincident with spikes
- batching: observed batching window on /chat went from median 8ms -> 12ms during spike (queue wobble)
Actions: 
1) revert the aggressive batching suggestion deployed for cohort B (today)
2) bump KV cache TTL for cohort B by +30s to reduce misses
ETA for changes + monitoring: ~6h

Maya (CS): Good. Please add a short note for Jamal's renewal deck (1-2 bullets) with impact and mitigation. @Sasha please draft enablement note + streaming code sample.

Sasha (PM): Will do — draft will include a minimal streaming SDK snippet and a tiny diagram showing prefix caching. ETA for draft: EOD today.

Jamal (AE): I'll schedule a 30m sync with the customer this week. @Maya (CS) can you join?

Maya (CS): Yep, I'll join. Thanks all — keep me posted if the p99s start trending down. :thumbsup:

Devon (SRE): I'll post a short follow-up once the revert + TTL change is live and we have 1h of post-change telemetry.

OpsBot: note: ticket #CS-8421 created for cohort B action items (devon/ops).

Maya (CS): Ok closing this thread for now — reconvene if regressions.
